text_block_list.text: The day of the Hopeful Stakes had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Today's Heartful Gretel was it? I heard 
it's the first ever underwater race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. So at last then, it is time to show 
the world my graceful butterfly!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Pacific Ocean…! I'm gonna 
cross the Japan Trench!

Her ideas sound questionable at best but 
at least she looks in the mood…!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I can cross a trench or 
two with ease!
